listing.name: [WIP] Europa Federation
listing.summary: Adds a faction with ships, weapons, and strikecraft, featuring two new star systems in the south of the sector.
listing.aiSummary: Adds a faction with ships, weapons, and strikecraft, featuring two new star systems in the south of the sector.

description:
A faction pack containing a faction with ships, weapons and strikecraft.

Two star systems are added in the south of the sector, "Europa" and "Carthage". 
The Europa Federation prefer energy weapons and have a emphasis on point defence.

This is very much work in progress and something I do in my spare time. 

This is my first mod and I am looking for any helpful feedback or suggestions.
I would be grateful if someone could assist me in creating some missions and stations!

Requires:
Magic, Shader and LunaLib

Download

https://drive.google.com/file/d/1NbOv77Q0GEERnH8pilU4WxMzSjbhiG3X/view?usp=sharing

Changelog

17/01/26 - Added Carpathia class family of ships(Thanks to Bigbeans for initial sprite) 
                 Added Tallinn class family of ships
                 Added Ehammer Torpedo , Talos point defence missile , Catalyst Cluster Bomber 

23/09/26 - Re-drew a number of sprites (Thanks to BigBeans)

               - Added Nex integration
